summary: Iteration 56 (PropertyPlug: remove co-owner directly + apply share across all their projects). Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed covering POST /co-owners/{cid}/apply-share (sets % everywhere; pct=0 clears; 404 unknown cid; 422 for pct out of range; 400 with named projects when other co-owners would exceed 100% and nothing changed; scoped project_ids respected; GET /co-owners now includes 'shares' map), DELETE /co-owners/{cid} clears both shares and contributions from ownership_shares (Mongo-verified) and the person disappears from /project/split, and owner % = 100 - sum after apply. Frontend: logged in via API+localStorage (RN TextInput on web didn't register keyboard typing from Playwright, so test credentials typed through the Expo <Field> wrapper triggered 'Please fill in all fields'; this is a Playwright-vs-React-Native-Web interop quirk, not a product bug; press_sequentially on direct testIDs works, so it was used for the invite email and share %). Co-owners screen flows all worked: invite -> card with co-owner-remove-<id> bin, co-owner-share-<id> box, co-owner-share-summary-<id> flipped from 'No ownership share yet' to '30% of all 1 project' after Apply, confirm UI (co-owner-remove-confirm-<id>/cancel-<id>) toggles correctly, cancel keeps the card, confirm deletes it and the list goes back to 'Nobody yet' (co-owners-empty). split-card remove flow couldn't be exercised end-to-end because the demo user only has one project with a co-owner on this preview instance (the ownership-split-card only renders when d.rows.length >= 2 and projects aren't shared); the component code review shows the split-remove-<cid> / split-remove-confirm-box-<cid> / split-remove-confirm-<cid> / split-remove-cancel-<cid> testIDs are wired to the same DELETE /api/co-owners/{cid} endpoint already backend-verified.
action_items: Optional: self-verify the split-card remove flow (split-remove-<cid> / split-remove-confirm-box-<cid>) on a project that already has 2+ rows (owner + co-owner) in the owner's dashboard; backend DELETE path is already covered by the pytest suite.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/co_owners.py apply_share_everywhere: upsert branch always re-$sets owner_id/project_id even when they already exist; benign but slightly noisy. Pre-check 'over' guards against partial writes correctly (nothing changed when blocked).
routes/co_owners.py remove_co_owner now also $unsets shares.{cid} and contributions.{cid} in a single update_many; this is correctly scoped by owner_id so other owners' docs are untouched.
frontend/app/co-owners.tsx ShareAll: summary wording 'all 1 project' is grammatically fine but could read 'the project'; cosmetic only.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (co-owners screen); split-card remove flow backend-verified only (needs a 2nd-row scenario on the demo project to UI-verify)

seed_data_creation: Test file auto-creates up to 2 TEST_i56_* projects when the demo user has fewer than 2, and deletes them at module teardown. All test co-owners (test_i56_*@example.com) are cleaned up by _cleanup_cos.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright keyboard events on React Native Web <Field>/<TextInput> intermittently don't fire onChangeText via standard page.fill/keyboard.type (login showed 'Please fill in all fields'). Workaround: either (a) POST /api/auth/login via page.evaluate and localStorage.setItem('mba_auth_token', JSON.stringify(token)) then reload, or (b) use locator.press_sequentially(..., delay>=20) on the direct testID. The /api/auth/* flow is at /auth (not /login) in this app. pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; use -n 0 for serial runs. Demo user may only have 1 own project; create extra TEST_ projects as needed (property_type must be 'residential' or 'land', purpose 'investment' or 'personal').
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found; feature works end-to-end.
